questions.question: What is the altimeter reading (in feet)?

uiSpec.description: Three-needle altimeter showing 18,000 feet (ten-thousands window) + 1,500 feet (thin needle) = 18,500 feet.

questions.explanation: Read the altimeter: the ten-thousands window shows 1 (=10,000 ft), thin needle at 5 (=500 ft), thick needle at 8 (=8,000 ft). Total: 10,000 + 8,000 + 500 = 18,500 feet.
questions.fastStrategy: Three-needle altimeter: window (ten-thousands) + thick needle (thousands) + thin needle (hundreds).

questions.question: What is the airspeed (in knots)?

uiSpec.description: Airspeed indicator with pointer at 120 knots.

questions.explanation: Read the airspeed indicator directly: the needle points to 120 on the scale.
steps: 2. Find needle position on circular dial.
4. Verify needle is between 100 and 150 markings, closer to 120.
questions.fastStrategy: Airspeed indicator: read needle position directly from dial in knots.
